personal.name: Mujeeb P
personal.bio: specialized in crafting fast, beautiful, and scalable digital experiences. Passionate about bridging the gap between clean frontend code, system performance, and polished user interface design.

paragraphs: I enjoy building products that combine beautiful interfaces with practical solutions. My interests include frontend engineering, AI-powered applications, and UI/UX design.
I don't just write code—I design and build complete digital experiences, from UI mockups and client architecture down to backend APIs and automated deployment.

projects.title: StudyFlow AI
projects.description:
• Problem: Students waste time reading long PDFs and documents.
• Solution: AI summarizes documents and extracts key learnings instantly.
• Tech: Next.js, OpenAI API, Tailwind CSS, Vector DB
projects.challenges: Optimizing vector embedding retrieval speeds and handling long PDF token context limits.

projects.title: ITQAN Friends Website

projects.title: Vogue Vault
projects.description:
• Problem: E-commerce shopping catalogs suffer from laggy filters and layouts.
• Solution: Engineered a high-performance shopping interface with instant filtering.
• Tech: React, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion

projects.title: Hardware Lab Management
projects.description:

• Solution: Managed daily lab operations, upgraded NVMe SSDs, and recovered unreadable drives.
• Tech: Linux, Hardware Diagnostics, Virtualization
projects.challenges: Performing bit-level data recovery on damaged 1TB storage clusters without data corruption.

projects.title: Multimedia Production
projects.description:
